vision.sin_indicadores: The required field indicadores_calidad is missing.

ingesta.kpi_errores_sub: structure, authentication, time, unit, sensor, duplicates
ingesta.saturacion_nota: Under saturation, the queue is processed by composite priority: 1) severity (critical before non-critical), 2) criticality of the source area by its area_id (high, medium, low), 3) data type (heartbeat, control events, routine telemetry), 4) source (real time before local buffer) and 5) age. It only reorders: if the queue cannot take more messages, the broker answers RETENER or ERROR_SATURACION and the device keeps the data in its local buffer (72 h) and retries.
ingesta.sin_resultados: No reading matches the filters. Remove one to see more.
ingesta.ajuste_no_aplica_vision: Not applicable: the vector does not use offset and gain calibration
ingesta.fases_observacion: Got a remark in {{fase}} and is still stored.
ingesta.prioridad_e15_ayuda: Evaluated from 1 to 5. Area criticality comes from its area_id (RF-20) and from variables marked as critical (RF-17).
ingesta.nota_FUERA_DE_RANGO: It is outside the operating range: available for technical diagnosis and forensic analysis, but it does not feed the alert engine or production reports.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_CALIBRACION: Stored without calibration. The raw value is there to review and adjust the sensor; it is not used in production analysis until recalibrated.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_UNIDAD: The received unit ({{unidad}}) does not match the one configured for the sensor and there is no conversion rule. It is rejected and kept only in the log.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_TIEMPO: The capture time ({{capturado}}) is later than the server time when processed ({{procesado}}): the device clock is out of sync. It is rejected and kept only in the log.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_ESTRUCTURA: The message arrived incomplete or does not meet the required schema. It is rejected before processing and kept only in the log.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_AUTENTICACION: The device is not registered, not ACTIVE or its credentials are invalid. It is rejected and logged as a security event.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_DUPLICADO: A record with the same key (sensor, variable, capture and source) already exists. It is discarded with no effect (idempotency) and logged as DUPLICATE_EVENT.
ingesta.nota_ERROR_SENSOR: The value is physically impossible for this sensor. It is rejected, not stored in the main store, and the hardware should be checked.
ingesta.nota_area_vacia: n_individuos_observados = 0 is valid: the area is empty (not a camera without detection, see RF-60).
ingesta.nota_vision_defaults: Indicators marked (D) are default values, not yet measured on hardware.

edge.modo_presupuestos: Scalar: up to 500 ms per measurement. Vision: up to {{pct}} % of the observation window (default value). Works offline.
edge.vision_descripcion: The Edge builds the area's behavior vector and detects anomalies without supervision. Time is measured per observation window, not in milliseconds. Parameters are set in Configuration (M09); here they are read-only.
edge.valores_d: Default values (D), not yet measured on hardware.
edge.criterio_texto: Each window must finish processing before the next one closes. Otherwise the cascade enters backpressure and drops frames: cobertura_ventana goes down and that shows in the RF-62 quality index.
edge.no_encola: The system does not queue unprocessed windows.

pipeline.reglas_titulo: Rules for sending to the inference engine
pipeline.regla_buffer: Buffer on when the engine is unavailable
pipeline.payload_vision: Behavior vector: no value or unit; area_id, window, components and indicadores_calidad are required.
pipeline.payload_escalar: Scalar: severity, variables and package context.
pipeline.fallo_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE_desc: The package targets a model version the engine no longer accepts.
pipeline.fallo_ERROR_AUTENTICACION_desc: The engine rejected the TLS channel credentials.
pipeline.fallo_INCONSISTENCIA_TEMPORAL_desc: The context variables are more than 5 s apart.
pipeline.fallo_ESQUEMA_INVALIDO_desc: The vision envelope arrived without area_id and with scalar value and unit; pre-send validation rejects it.
pipeline.fallo_DESFASE_EXCEDIDO_desc: It comes from the buffer {{horas}} h old and exceeds the 72 h maximum (RFC-015 C2): it is not sent to the engine.
pipeline.reintentable: It can be retried ({{n}}/{{max}} attempts used).
pipeline.no_reintentable: Retrying will not fix it: the source must be corrected.

camaras.parametros_ayuda: They define when a device turns NO_SIGNAL and INACTIVE. They are set in Configuration (M09) and only the Administrator changes them; here they are read-only.
camaras.alias_nota: umbral_sin_senal is the canonical name (RFC-015 C1); heartbeat remains a deprecated alias. It is not the same as intervalo_heartbeat, which is the emission cadence.
camaras.params_camara: Cameras only: ventanas_consecutivas_sin_deteccion = {{n}} (range 1–20) and cobertura_minima_deteccion_valida = {{cobertura}} (range 0.05–0.90). Default values (D).
camaras.deteccion_ayuda: A camera without heartbeat is a device failure. A camera with heartbeat but low coverage for several windows in a row is a quality condition: it raises no technical alert.
camaras.consecutivas: {{n}} of {{max}} windows in a row below the minimum
camaras.nota_DETECCION_VALIDA: Coverage is above the minimum: the vector feeds quality and prediction.
camaras.nota_SIN_DETECCION_VALIDA: Quality condition, not a failure: there is heartbeat, but coverage stayed below the minimum in the latest windows (for example, turbidity). It raises no device alert.
camaras.nota_SIN_SENAL: Device failure: no heartbeat arrives within umbral_sin_senal and the technical alert DISPOSITIVO_SIN_SEÑAL is raised (RF-57). It does not feed vision quality.

calidadvision.ayuda: Each camera window gets its own quality index, separate from scalar readings. It comes from coverage, fps and tracking stability, adjusted by the area calibration status (RF-24).
calidadvision.parametros_titulo: Vision index parameters (default values, not measured on hardware)
calidadvision.nic41_nota: apto_para_nic41 is always false for vision: M06 does not use this data. DEGRADED class = usable for AI with low confidence.
calidadvision.inmutable: The stored evaluation is immutable: it uses the parameters in force when it was evaluated.
